title.en: An Act Restoring to the Public Domain Certain Lands in the Moro Province Reserved therefrom for Public Purposes By Executive Order of the Governor-General Numbered Ninety-three, Series of Nineteen Hundred and Eight.

text.en:
All of the public lands heretofore reserved for the use of the Moro Province by executive order
of the Governor-General Numbered Ninety-three and dated September eighteenth, nineteen hundred and
eight, are hereby restored to the public domain and reopened for settlement and sale in accordance with the
provisions of Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty-six, as amended, in a like manner and effect as if no
such reservation had been made.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 23, 1913.
